limit.description: The maximum number of objs returned.

offset.description: Index of first entry to return.

doNotThrowError.description:
Do not throw the error if transformations fail. Instead, returns errors field populated in
{@link TransformObjsResult}.

trackSources.description: When enabled, source objs will be populated in {@link TransformObjsResult#sourceObjs}.

trackSourceFields.description: When enabled, source fields will be populated in {@link TransformObjsResult#sourceFieldsByTransform}.

objs.description: A list of objs uploaded by users, which are usually existing in memory and not persisted yet.

sourceCollectionSpecs.description: A list of pairs of {@link SourceCollection} names and {@link ObjsOperSpec}s, used to load source objs from source collections.

transforms.description: A list of {@link Transform} instances to apply to the objects.
